L31·N10854unmasked layer
Fires on highly predictable "glue" tokens completing a familiar collocation or numeric pattern — e.g., the "a" in "on a budget", "to" in "we are to blame", "over" in "over browning", the "2" in "2013", the space before "7th" — rather than on content words; it is strongly suppressed on subword fragments of rare proper names/transliterations (e.g. "-ounced", "-on" in "Quinton", "Kali-y-ug").
